The petitioner is the sole accused in C.C No.138 of 2022 on the file of Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Kakkanad, arising out of Crime No.23 of 2022 of Thadiyattaparambu Police Station.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Kakkanad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The offence alleged against the petitioner is under Section 498A of IPC.
2.

According to the learned counsel for the petitioner, as per Annexure-A3, the marriage between the petitioner and the de facto complainant was dissolved on 06.11.2023 and on the basis of the above agreement, a sum of Rs.5,00,000/- was transferred to the account of the de facto complainant as per Annexure-A4 on 08.01.2022 and the present FIR was registered thereafter on 14.01.2022.
According to the learned counsel this is a false case foisted against the petitioner.
Therefore, he prayed for quashing all further proceedings against the petitioner.
3. Though notice was served, there is no representation for the 3rd respondent/de facto complainant.
4. The petition was opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor.
5. On a perusal of Annexure-A3, it can be seen that the 2025:KER:97833 marriage of the petitioner with the de facto complainant was dissolved on 06.11.2021.

From Annexure-A4, it is revealed that a sum of Rs.5,00,000/- was transferred to the account of the de facto complainant on 08.01.2021 in pursuance to Annexure-A3 and the FIR is seen registered only subsequently on 14.01.2022.
6.
On a perusal of FI Statement, it can be seen that, not even a single specific allegation with material particulars is mentioned in it.
Therefore, no useful purpose will be served in continuing the proceedings against the petitioner, and as such, this Crl.M.C is liable to be allowed.
In the result, This Crl. M.C is allowed.

All further proceedings against the petitioner in C.C No.138 of 2022 on the file of Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Kakkanad, arising from Crime No.23 of 2022 of Thadiyattaparambu Police Station, is quashed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
